examples.title: Counter
examples.description: Minimal state-changing contract -- increment/decrement a u256 counter. Good first contract to compile and run.

examples.description: While-loop control flow: accumulator/iteration patterns compiled through the SSA IR backend.

examples.description: Struct literals, nested field access/assignment, and functions that take/return structs (Point, Rect).

examples.title: V3 Types
examples.description: V3 type aliases, enums, attributes (@public/@authority), and Bech32 address builtins.

examples.title: Asset Demo
examples.description: Built-in asset lifecycle: asset_create / asset_transfer / asset_burn / balance and owner checks.

examples.description: 3-level nested map<K, map<K, map<K,V>>> demo -- domain -> record_type -> record_name -> value.

examples.title: Simple Token
examples.description: ERC-20-style token contract. Deploy alongside TokenVault to see the controller/asset pattern.

examples.title: Token Vault
examples.description: Controller contract that mints/burns SimpleToken via extern_call -- shows cross-contract calls.

examples.title: Comprehensive Token
examples.description: Full ERC-20-style surface plus bool/str/map<u256,bool>/map<u256,str> and str_concat/str_len/str_eq builtins. EIP-712 `as caller` auth on every mutator.
